description: GUI front-end for Microsoft Sysinternals Sigcheck to inspect file signatures, metadata, hashes, and VirusTotal results.
notes: STAGED FOR REVIEW ONLY. Do not move this manifest into bucket/ until the ZIP has been downloaded, its SHA-256 has been calculated, and its internal file layout and executable path have been verified.
